# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Ezra is an extremely unattractive and gangly young man with elongated legs. He has flaxen, limp, unkempt hair, green eyes, a large mouth, a scholarly forehead, impassioned eyes, and notable ears. Despite his plain looks, his voice is delightful.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

Ezra possesses a beautiful, earnest, and faithful nature, and he laughs and jokes frequently. He is deeply devoted to his calling, approaching it with seriousness and noble purpose. Although he displays a bright and cheerful demeanor, he can become solemn and passionate when speaking about spiritual matters.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c25 P13](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0013)_

## Traits

- earnest and faithful  <sub>[v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c25 P13](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0013)</sub>
- cheerful and humorous  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P13](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0013)</sub>
- devoted to his ministry  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018)</sub>

## Abilities

- effective and moving preaching  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- fulfill his calling as a minister and serve humanity  <sub>[v3 c24 P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018)</sub>
- lead a mission church in the slums of Tanner Street  <sub>[v3 c27 P30](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0030)</sub>

## History

Ezra attended Wexcombe College and studied theology at St. Columbia. During a summer break, he took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church, lodging at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse where he met Cressida Lindsay. He initially struggled with his religious calling but ultimately embraced it fully. After completing his theological studies at St. Columbia, he took over a small mission church in the Tanner Street slums. He proposed to Cressida Lindsay, and the two were married the following June.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P4](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0004), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c27 P30](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0030)_

## Quotes

> I attempted to be a different person for a extended period—I lacked the desire to be a clergyman. However, I eventually realized that it was the labor assigned to me—and with the assistance of God, I will endeavor to fulfill it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018)</sub>
